Humanoid · SM +0 Locathah [Monster Manual, page 169]

A lean yellow-green scaled fish-person with pearl eyes, neck gill fans and a crest running from crown to back, carrying a long spear. They live in organised communities on the sea floor, trade when approached properly, and fight well in defence of their own.
